name: FATCA Status
definition: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) status and the status source of the investor.

FATCAStatus.name: FATCA Status
FATCAStatus.definition: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) status of the investor.

FATCASourceStatus.name: FATCA Source Status
FATCASourceStatus.definition: Source of the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) status.

FATCAReportingDate.name: FATCA Reporting Date
FATCAReportingDate.definition: Date provided by the account owner to inform the account servicer of the date on which the holdings must be reported before the account is subsequently closed.

InvestmentAccountParty.name: Investment Account Party
InvestmentAccountParty.definition: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) status linked to an investment account and played by a party in that context.
